file: 376 Why Hatsune Miku Always Holds a Leek.mp4

lines.t: Hatsune Miku can fight with a leek in Fortnite now. But why a leek?

full.credit: Clips: Leekspin (2006); Ievan Polkka cover; VALtheVAL; FireMonkey (YouTube)

lines.t: In 2006, a looping animation went viral. An anime girl from Bleach, spinning a leek, to a Finnish folk song called Ievan Polkka.

full.credit: Clips: Leekspin (2006); Ievan Polkka cover; VALtheVAL; FireMonkey (YouTube)

lines.say: In 2006, a looping animation went viral. An anime girl from Bleach, spinning a leek, to a Finnish folk song called Eevan Polka.

lines.t: In 2007, someone made Hatsune Miku sing that song. And in the video, a tiny Miku shakes a leek.

full.credit: Clips: Leekspin (2006); Ievan Polkka cover; VALtheVAL; FireMonkey (YouTube)

lines.t: It became one of her first big hits. And the leek stuck to her forever. Now it's in Fortnite.

full.credit: Clips: Leekspin (2006); Ievan Polkka cover; VALtheVAL; FireMonkey (YouTube)

lines.t: Did you know where the leek came from?
